notes: §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.2: "Associating the figurative constant ALL literal where the length of the literal is greater than one with a data item that is numeric or numeric edited is an obsolete feature", so at 85 it is legal and means what the clause's length rule (the string "repeated character by character on the right until the size of the resultant string is greater than or equal to the number of character positions in the associated data item", GRL2.1) and the MOVE of an alphanumeric sender (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR4) make it. GateSr3/GateSr5 ask the registry row all-literal-multichar-numeric-removed-2002 (silent at 85, COBOL0902 from 2002) for MOVE (GateMove), INITIALIZE REPLACING (GateInitialize) and relations (CheckRelationalOperands); MoveEmitter.AllLiteralNumber (kb/Work PB5176) repeats the digits to the receiver's size in standard data format characters at 85; in a relation the figurative is repeated to the length of ComparisonText's temporary, which at 85 counts a SIGN SEPARATE position (OperandText.AsComparisonTemporary1985, kb/Work PB5569). Probed at --std 85 on tree dc1f2dcce8 (MOVE, INITIALIZE and relation forms; see the row's history) and re-probed after PB5569: S9(3) SIGN LEADING and TRAILING SEPARATE 121 = ALL "12" false in either order ("1212" against "121 "), PIC 9(3) 121 = ALL "12" true. Witnesses 1985-SR-IV_4_2_2_2_3-L3_2 (MOVE) and 1985-GR-VI_6_3_1_1_2-1-sign-separate (relations). History: the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) overturned CONFORMS to PARTIAL (the ALL literal sized to the digits of a SIGN SEPARATE item, kb/Work PB5569); PB5569 fixed it.

next.reason: 1985: "ALL literal where the length of the literal is greater than one with a data item that is numeric or numeric edited is an obsolete feature"; 2023: "permitted to move an ALL "literal" figurative constant (containing only digits) ... to an integer numeric item. In all other cases ... prohibited". 1985 keeps any multi-character ALL literal with numeric or numeric-edited items as obsolete. 2023 keeps only digit-only literals moved to integer numeric items and prohibits all other cases.
